## 📥 Input & Validation
Receives Telegram messages, validates sender, and extracts LinkedIn URLs.

## 🔄 Scrape & Persona
Scrapes original post content and loads your personal writing style.

## 🤖 AI Generation
Rewrites post in your voice using Gemini, then creates an image prompt.

## 🎨 Image & Preview
Generates image with Gemini Imagen and sends preview to Telegram.

## ✅ Approval Flow
Waits for your yes/no response in Telegram before proceeding.

## 🚀 Publish
Posts to LinkedIn with image and sends confirmation to Telegram.

options.systemMessage:
=# LinkedIn Post Rewriter - Match Writing Style

Rewrite this LinkedIn post to match the target persona's style exactly.

## Original Post
Author: {{ $json.originalAuthor }}
Engagement: {{ $json.originalEngagement }} likes

{{ $json.originalPostText }}

## Target Persona
Name: {{ $json.persona.name }}
Tone: {{ $json.persona.style.tone }}
Voice: {{ $json.persona.style.voice }}
Formatting: {{ $json.persona.style.formatting }}
Hooks: {{ $json.persona.style.hooks }}
CTA Style: {{ $json.persona.style.callToAction }}
Length: {{ $json.persona.postLength }}
Expertise: {{ $json.persona.expertiseAreas.join(', ') }}
Common Phrases: {{ $json.persona.commonPhrases.join(', ') }}
Emojis: {{ $json.persona.preferredEmojis.join(' ') }}

## Requirements

**Content to Preserve:**
- All URLs/links from original (keep exact URLs)
- Key statistics and data points
- Company/product names mentioned
- Core message and insights

**Style Matching:**
- Match their typical hooks and opening style
- Use their common phrases naturally
- Follow their tone, voice, and formatting
- Include 2-5 of their preferred emojis
- Match their CTA style
- Add 3-5 hashtags at end

**LinkedIn Native Formatting (SUPPORTED):**
✅ **Bold text** - Use for titles/emphasis (surround with *asterisks*)
✅ *Italic text* - Use for subtle emphasis (surround with _underscores_)
✅ Line breaks and spacing for structure
✅ Emojis for visual hierarchy (⚡💡🎯→✨)
✅ CAPS for strong emphasis
✅ Preserve any URLs exactly as they appear
✅ Hashtags on last line only

❌ NOT supported: # headers, - markdown bullets, > quotes, [link](url) syntax

**How to format for LinkedIn:**
- Bold titles: *Title Text Here* (LinkedIn converts to bold)
- Italic: _subtle emphasis_ (LinkedIn converts to italic)
- Bullets: Use emojis or → symbol
- Spacing: Line breaks for readability

**Structure:**
1. Hook (their style, can use *bold* for impact)
2. Body (their voice & formatting)
3. Key points (emoji bullets or structured)
4. CTA (their typical style)
5. Hashtags (3-5 at end)

## Output Format

Return ONLY valid JSON:
```json
{
  "post": "Complete post here\n\nWith line breaks\n\n*Bold Title If Needed*\n\nPreserved URLs: https://example.com\n\n#Hashtag1 #Hashtag2"
}
```

Rules:
- Entire post in single "post" field
- Use \n for line breaks, \n\n for paragraphs
- Use *text* for bold, _text_ for italic
- Include ALL original URLs unchanged
- Ready to paste into LinkedIn

Return ONLY the JSON. No explanations. No code fences. Just the JSON object.

## LinkedIn Viral Post Creator
**Telegram Bot → AI Rewrite → Auto-Post**

### How It Works
1. Send a LinkedIn post URL to your Telegram bot
2. AI rewrites it in YOUR style + generates an image
3. Preview in Telegram, approve or reject
4. Approved posts go live on LinkedIn

### Setup Required
1. **Telegram Bot** - Create via @BotFather
2. **Google Gemini API** - For AI writing & images
3. **ConnectSafely.ai** - For LinkedIn scraping
4. **LinkedIn OAuth** - For posting
5. **Your Telegram ID** - Update Security Check node
6. **Your Persona** - Customize the Load Persona node
